tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: The display itself: the background of the car screen and of the phone app. Nothing behind content is lighter than this.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards on `ground`: the dialog card, the detail panel, the phone's cards.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Tiles, chips and list rows on `ground` or `surface`; the body of the in-car pop-up.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and tile edges on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`. Decoration only: never the sole sign of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Edges that carry meaning (control outlines, the pop-up frame, the dashed edge of an unavailable reading). At least 3:1 on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and readings on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: ink-dim
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels, units and provenance notes on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The assistant's own colour: push-to-talk, the active tab, links, connected-state marks, info events. Text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`; as a fill it takes `on-signal`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `signal` fill.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning severity: the car's yellow messages and an owner limit that was reached. Always beside a word or an icon. Text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`; as a fill it takes `on-warning`.

tokens.name: on-warning
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `warning` fill.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity: the car's red messages. Always beside a word or an icon, and darker than `warning` so the two differ in lightness as well as hue. Text and icons on `ground`, `surface`, `surface-raised`; as a fill it takes `on-critical`.

tokens.name: on-critical
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a `critical` fill.

styles.name: reading-xl
styles.usage: The one large reading of a sensor tile.

styles.name: reading
styles.usage: Readings in strips and compact tiles.

styles.name: answer-driving
styles.usage: The assistant's answer while the car is moving: three lines at most.

styles.name: answer
styles.usage: The assistant's answer while the car is standing, and pop-up body text.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and pop-up headings, chip text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Upper-case labels: tabs, tile names, provenance tags. The smallest text allowed on the car screen.

styles.name: phone-title
styles.usage: Screen and section headings on the phone.

styles.name: phone-body
styles.usage: Answers, list rows and settings on the phone.

styles.name: phone-label
styles.usage: Upper-case labels and provenance tags on the phone.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between an icon or a status dot and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between tiles, chips and list rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding of chips and phone cards; gap between a label and its reading.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding of tiles and panels on the car screen; gap between columns.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the car screen's content; padding of the pop-up.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags and small marks.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Tiles, chips, cards, panels and the pop-up.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status pills, the push-to-talk button and level-meter bars.
